profile.headline: Senior SWE at Google + Writer
profile.summary:
I am a senior software engineer at Google, working on Google Search. I graduated from Stanford University with my B.S. and M.S. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) in June 2018.

In my other life, I'm also a traditionally published author of fantasy novels! Check out authorhanalee.com for my upcoming releases.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Oct 2022-March 2023): Frontend engineer for Google.org, collaborating with the State of California on www.planscape.org, a planning tool to maximize wildfire resilience and ecological benefits.

Working on App Actions (https://developers.google.com/assistant/app) to help third-party app developers seamlessly integrate with Google Assistant.

positions.title: Virtual Reality Programmer
positions.description: Programmed virtual worlds and simulations for behavioral studies

positions.title: Financial Director
positions.description:
Handle finances, fundraising, and reimbursements for the Stanford Archery team
Paid coach for Junior Olympic Archery Development (JOAD) program through USA Archery
Paid private and group lessons coach (Level 2 certified)

positions.title: Technical Writer Intern
positions.description:
Wrote technical documentation for several of Palantir's commercially-focused products, including:
- Code Editor, a web-based IDE
- Stemma, Palantir's version of Git
- Analysis, a report-generating data visualization tool

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Managed 5-7 mailing lists of department members
Handled reimbursements for faculty, post-docs, graduate students, and visitors
Updated department website
Managed financial and administrative spreadsheets.

Currently working with department administrator Julie Shih to bring theoretical physics lectures from Stanford faculty to the general public via YouTube and the department website

positions.title: Technical Writer Intern
positions.description:
Developed and maintained AtlasConsole, a CLI in Groovy for querying AtlasDB (a KVS database), for two release cycles
Wrote an advanced user’s guide for AtlasConsole intended for a highly technical audience
Developed a mock version of AtlasConsole in Python, to be used as a documentation exercise for applicants to the Technical Writing Intern position at Palantir

positions.title: YouthLine Operator
positions.description:
Acted as a youth crisis specialist and trained phone operator at Lines for Life
Designed and implemented outreach programs for suicide awareness in Portland public schools

positions.title: Youth Programs Liaison
positions.description:
Acted as a liaison between the YouthLine and the Youth Advisory Council
Assisted in training new crisis line volunteers in June and September 2013

honors.title: English Departmental Award
honors.description: Awarded to a single graduating senior who has shown excellence in English
honors.issuer: Issued by Oregon Episcopal School · Jun 2013

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked as a youth suicide and mental health hotline operator and participated in visibility campaigns for YouthLine and the cause of youth suicide prevention.
